content: No execution of on-exit ExecutableEntitys before termi- nating mode disabling dependent ExecutableEntitys Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00143, SRS_Rte_00213, SRS_Rte_00018 The RTE generator shall reject configurations that, for a synchronous mode switch, allow the execution of core local mode user group on- exit ExecutableEntitys while the mode disabling dependent Exe- cutableEntitys of that mode machine instance are not terminated.

The RTE generator shall reject configurations with mode disabling dependent ExecutableEntitys that are mapped to a task with lower priority than the task that contains the on-entry ExecutableEnti- tys and on-exit ExecutableEntitys of that core local mode user group supporting a synchronous mode switching procedure.
